soft_anchor.hypothesis: Opening closer to the supplier's price keeps it cooperative and avoids walk-aways in relationship cases (stabilise, secure_supply).

deep_anchor.hypothesis: A lower opening drags the settlement down where we have leverage (rivals, market data).

fast_concede.hypothesis: Bigger, earlier steps reach a deal before the supplier hardens or issues a final offer.

slow_concede.hypothesis: Smaller steps and a longer horizon extract more from suppliers that keep moving.

eager_close.hypothesis: Accepting once the supplier is within ~2 % of our target avoids losing deals to one counter too many.

deep_fast.hypothesis: Deep anchor and fast concession together: the low opening sets the range, the big steps keep the supplier engaged (both helped P08 alone).

mid_anchor.hypothesis: A moderately deeper anchor keeps deep_anchor's gain (P08) without its loss on P18.

firm_close.hypothesis: Since accepting early hurt (eager_close), holding out for a closer match to our target gains more.

firm_deep_fast.hypothesis: firm_close's gain (P02) and deep_fast's gains (P07, P08) add up in one strategy.

measured_meet.hypothesis: When the supplier jumps further than the gap left, closing only 20 % of the gap (not 50 %) keeps us from overshooting: P01's supplier 'agreed' at once to our half-way offer.

no_meet.hypothesis: Pure reciprocity (half of their step, capped by our curve) without any 'meet it' rule.

weight_order.hypothesis: Settling the term worth most EUR first (P01: the start date, EUR 25k) beats always opening with payment days.

no_reopen.hypothesis: Moving on to the next term instead of a second menu on a locked costly one gets more terms onto the table (P01 re-asked payment days and never offered April).

one_step.hypothesis: One term menu, then price rounds: fewer rounds spent on terms the supplier answers in its own favour.

measured_firm.hypothesis: measured_meet plus firm_close (the only variant with no loss so far).

deep_one_step.hypothesis: deep_anchor's P08 gain and one_step's raw-material gains (P08, P18) add up.

firm_one_step.hypothesis: one_step's raw-material gains plus firm_close's P02 gain, without deep anchoring.
